tools.name: openExpenseForm
tools.description: Open the interactive expense form so the user can enter an expense themselves. Call this immediately whenever the user wants to submit, file, add, or log an expense. Do NOT ask the user for the merchant, amount, currency, category, or date first — the form collects them. Pass any details the user already mentioned as prefill values; omit anything they did not say rather than guessing.

merchant.description: Prefill: merchant or vendor name, if the user mentioned one.

amount.description: Prefill: amount as a positive number, if the user mentioned one.

currency.description: Prefill: ISO 4217 currency code, if the user mentioned one.

category.description: Prefill: category, if it is clear from what the user said.

date.description: Prefill: date in YYYY-MM-DD format, if the user mentioned one.

tools.name: submitExpense
tools.description: Record a business expense (merchant, amount, currency, category, date) and return a confirmation with the created expense id. Called by the expense form widget when the user submits it.

merchant.description: Merchant or vendor name, for example 'Lufthansa' or 'Hotel Adlon'.

amount.description: Expense amount as a positive number, without a currency symbol.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example EUR or USD. Defaults to EUR.

date.description: Date the expense was incurred, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: listExpenses
tools.description: Return the most recently submitted expenses.

limit.description: Maximum number of expense rows to return.
